### NVM for Windows Documentation

#### Description

## Definitions

### NVM
- Stands for "Node Version Manager".
- Used to manage which versions of node and npm are installed.
- There are Windows and POSIX versions - if NVM becomes relevant to a task, ensure you are using the correct project's documentation (as determined by the operating system currently being used).
